BrochureContent.Content:
An Exceptional Detached Family Home with Self-Contained Log Cabin Studio in a Prime Residential Location

Situated in the ever-popular residential area of Lehenaghmore, this impressive, detached home combines generous living accommodation, timeless style and outstanding versatility. Ideally positioned within easy reach of Wilton, Cork Airport, University College Cork (UCC), Munster Technological University (MTU), Cork University Hospital, Cork City Centre and the South Link Road, the property enjoys exceptional convenience for families and commuters alike.

Beautifully maintained and lovingly cared for by its current owners, the property is presented in superb decorative condition throughout. Offering spacious and well-balanced accommodation, every room has been thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and practicality, making it an ideal home for growing families while allowing a purchaser to move straight in and enjoy.
The heart of this exceptional home is the magnificent open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, created by an impressive rear extension. Designed with modern family living in mind, the beautifully appointed kitchen features a substantial centre island, providing the perfect focal point for everyday life and entertaining. Large openings lead seamlessly to a covered outdoor entertaining area, creating a wonderful flow between the indoor and outdoor spaces.

Finished with a classic yet contemporary flair, the home boasts elegant décor throughout, complemented by striking wallpapers, carefully chosen colour palettes and quality finishes that create a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Outside, the private south-facing rear garden enjoys sunshine throughout the day and offers a wonderful setting for relaxing or entertaining. To the front, a generous brick-paved and freshly tarmacked driveway provides ample off-street parking and is complemented by secure entrance gates, creating both an attractive first impression and additional privacy. A detached gym/garden room provides valuable additional space, while the separate self-contained two-bedroom log cabin studio offers exceptional flexibility, making it ideal for extended family, guests, a home business or potential rental income (subject to any necessary consents)

Offering a superb combination of style, space and convenience in one of Cork's most sought-after residential locations, this outstanding home is sure to appeal to a wide range of discerning purchasers.

***Joint Selling Agents With Cahalane Skuse Auctioneers & Valuers (021) 427 9179***

Size: 208 sq metres  (2238 sq ft)
Superb Detached Residence 
Driveway with parking for 6 cars
Gas Fired Central Heating
Large South facing private rear garden 
Sun room 
Detached self contained 2 bedroom log Cabin (44m2)
Immaculate condition throughout 
CCTV
Fully insulated
BER B2 (Access to green mortgage) 
Solar panels with 9KW/H battery
Sash windows
Timber window blinds/shutters
Stira leading to floored attic
8ft external fireplace and dining area
10 mins to Cork City Centre & 10 mins to Cork Airport
